title: Affordances of stairs
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings and behavioural responses collected while participants viewed images of scenes and rated aesthetic properties (beauty, complexity, interestingness) or judged their appropriateness for reading or social activities. The study investigates perceived affordances of environments, particularly staircases, using neural and behavioural measures. Full stimulus images and extracted behavioural data accompany the raw EEG recordings.
methods_description: Participants viewed images of scenes and rated their aesthetic properties (beauty, complexity, interestingness) or their appropriateness for a reading or social activity, while EEG was recorded. Behavioural responses were also collected and extracted from the EEG event markers for convenience.
